historical_record.description: Designed by Irvine & Ebbets — a mid-block example of the 1920s habit of setting garage doors at one or both sides of the main front, one for entry and one for exit.

The City Planning Commission unanimously found the tentative map for converting the building's 24 units to condominiums consistent with the Master Plan, although one unit rented in the moderate-income range (Resolution 7885).
